name: tools-ycompress-1
title: Ycompress 1.10
description:
This program can decompress and dump most of the graphics in Yoshi's Island, so that they can be modified by your SNES tile editor of choice. The program can then be used to recompress and insert the graphics back into the ROM.

Instructions on using the program are within the readme.txt file included in the zip file.

Version 1.10 January 1, 2022
-added 64 bit build of the program, which you can find in the x64
folder.
-added support for unicode filenames/paths when running on a unicode
OS.
-added support for ROMs without a copier header.
